english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being liable or predisposed to an unwanted result, as in prone to failure.
Use this pattern when someone or something is liable or prone to do what follows the verb.

examples.english: This old phone is prone to breaking down.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 jung4 ji6 waai6 gaa3

examples.english: In winter, the windows are apt to fog up.
examples.jyutping: dung1 tin1 di1 bo1 lei1 jung4 ji6 hei2 mou6
